_doc_header: SAVVYDFIR-MCP investigation manifest TEMPLATE. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with your case-specific values before launching claude. Copy this file to a case-specific name if you want to keep multiple cases.
investigation_goal: Identify initial access vector, persistence mechanisms, lateral movement paths, credential theft, and data exfiltration. Document all findings with evidence artifacts.

investigative_taxonomy._keywords_note: Optional seed terms (process names, IPs, users, file paths) known prior to investigation. LLM uses these for first-pivot anchoring per DFIR + Diamond Model methodology.

workflow_guidance.description: Staged-flow investigation per W1.7 (CR12 design review). Main-agent inline analysis is PRIMARY; specialist Task spawn is opt-in for cross-artifact isolation only. dotnet disk tools MUST run sequentially on 4-vCPU SIFT (repo-enforced via _recommended_batch_mode_for_tool).

phase_0_dip.label: Digital Investigative Plan
phase_0_dip.action: Read investigative_taxonomy above. Form initial hypothesis seed from intel/scope. Defines investigation destination (prevents rabbit holes per Advanced Digital Forensics methodology).

phase_1_volatile.label: Volatile Capture (RFC 3227 order — parallel-safe)
phase_1_volatile.note: Run in one batch. RFC 3227: CPU registers (microseconds) → process command lines, DLLs, open files (lost on restart) → disk. Memory analysis is the primary way to defeat Trojan-defense per DFIR; courts view failure to capture memory as negligent.

phase_2_disk_staging.label: Disk Staging (SEQUENTIAL — dotnet 4-vCPU constraint)
phase_2_disk_staging.note: Never run two dotnet tools in parallel. USN rolls over — do not delay. Each extraction injects relevant heuristic slice via Tier-1 (CR13 Option X) — agent receives forensic context with the data.
phase_2_disk_staging.file_access_extractors_note: The final five (extract_shellbags, extract_lnk_files, extract_jump_lists, extract_browser_history, extract_registry_fileaccess) are FK-only user-activity / file-access extractors. RECOMMENDED when the case involves data collection, file staging, physical access, browser downloads, or user navigation (e.g. investigative_taxonomy.dispute_type intrusion_response / data_exfiltration). OPTIONAL: they never block generate_report and are not in the coverage gate; on a mount-less or non-Windows image they return an EXPLICIT error (e.g. no_windows_volume_at_image_path), not a silent skip. The dotnet parsers (SBECmd/LECmd/JLECmd/RECmd) run SEQUENTIALLY per the no-two-dotnet-in-parallel rule; extract_browser_history is sqlite3 (cheap). DEPTH DIRECTIVE: after extracting EACH, run targeted run_analysis(csv_path, query=...) and submit_finding for evidence-backed navigation / collection / initial-access candidates -- do NOT mark the lane COMPLETE on extraction alone. DEFENSIBLE LANGUAGE: these artifacts INDICATE folder navigation, file reference, and user activity (LNK + ShellBag + RecentDocs corroboration indicates file access; a browser download indicates a possible initial-access vector) -- they do NOT prove file contents were read or exfiltrated.

phase_3_detection_anchors.label: Detection Anchors (deterministic)
phase_3_detection_anchors.note: sigma_hunt MANDATORY (2,278 community rules). hayabusa_hunt OPTIONAL (3,700+ rules, MITRE matrix) — cross-engine validation when both run. analyze_vss only if sigma finds EID 1102 (log cleared).

phase_4_hypothesis_formation.label: AI Hypothesis Formation (LLM brain step)
phase_4_hypothesis_formation.note: Call prepare_hypothesis_context(case_id) to receive a bundle: taxonomy + volatile summary + detection_anchors (top-N, NOT raw 502) + execution_anomalies + open_corrections + data_gaps + applicable_heuristics (heuristic slices from .claude/agents/*-analyst.md with CTX provenance refs). Form 2-5 ranked hypotheses with attack_class + initial_pivot + expected_evidence_chain + source_context_refs. Persist via record_hypotheses(case_id, hypotheses=[...]).

phase_5_pivot_loop.label: Diamond Model Pivot Loop
phase_5_pivot_loop.note: Per top hypothesis: drill targeted query around its pivot point via run_analysis. Vertical correlation (drill single Activity Thread) OR horizontal correlation (sweep across victims/artifacts). Call get_heuristic(artifact, topic) for on-demand DFIR depth. Cite heuristic_context_refs (CTX-NNN) on every finding for court-defensible provenance. Iterate until evidence chain converges OR all leads exhausted.

phase_6_activity_thread.label: Activity Thread Mapping + Contradiction Resolution
phase_6_activity_thread.note: compare_disk_and_memory is MANDATORY (10 anti-forensics checks). Contradictions trigger CorrectionEvent audit rows (W1.5) — the structural self-correction proof for criterion #1 tiebreaker. Findings map to Cyber Kill Chain phases via mitre_techniques; empty phase = blindspot (Diamond Axiom 4 — every phase must have evidence).

phase_7_reporting.label: Reporting (TTP-first narrative)
phase_7_reporting.note: Report headlines TTP-level findings (per Pyramid of Pain — hunt TTPs > IOCs). Activity Thread section shows filled vs empty kill-chain phases (blindspot reporting). Mermaid evidence chain DAG cites CTX-NNN heuristic provenance + execution_id linkage for criterion #5 audit trail.

opt_in_specialist_task_spawn.label: Cross-artifact subagent escape hatch
opt_in_specialist_task_spawn.when: synthesis or corroboration that benefits from context isolation
opt_in_specialist_task_spawn.note: Subagents have a 32K output-token ceiling (anthropics/claude-code#25569). Use only when isolation outweighs the truncation risk. Artifact-level analysis stays inline.
